verdict.rationale: Runpod's pricing page lists current-generation datacenter GPUs such as the B300 (288 GB HBM3e at $8.99/hr), and users pick GPU types per Pod via `--gpu-id`. Independent users note H100s are easy to get, while the 4090 mention and the lower-priced Community Cloud point to cheaper options. missing for 10: an explicit documented catalog naming H100/H200/B200 alongside older datacenter GPUs (e.g. A100/A40) with tiered pricing, and evidence of reliable availability for the cheaper tiers (one user reported 4090 'low availability' messages).
